name: LP vault v2 (canonical, USDC / tBOING pool)
summary: Deposit both tokens, the vault adds liquidity to a v8/v9 pool and mints vault shares 1:1 with the LP; withdraw burns shares and the pool pays you directly.

functions.name: configure
functions.description: Bind the vault to its pool and token pair.

functions.name: deposit
functions.description: Pull both amounts from the caller, add liquidity to the pool, mint shares.
functions.access: Anyone who approved the vault for both amounts.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.description: Burn shares; the pool pays both tokens straight to the caller.
functions.access: Share holders (burns the caller's own shares).

functions.name: transfer_shares
functions.description: Move vault shares to another account.
